working_state_revisions.semantics: Append-only, strictly monotonically increasing revision numbers with cryptographic hash chaining (previous_state_hash)

runs.constraint: Partial unique index idx_agent_run_one_active_per_investigation enforces maximum 1 active run per investigation

delegations.lifecycle: queued -> running -> completed / failed / stale / cancelled

trajectory.semantics: Immutable append-only audit trail with sequence numbers (seq)

http_boundary.conflict_behavior: Immediate HTTP 409 Conflict rejection if cycle is already executing

optimistic_revision_guard.conflict_behavior: Raises WorkingStateRevisionConflictError; HTTP route maps to 409 Conflict

idempotency.idempotency_keys: Supported on start_run and commit_working_state; retries with identical keys return original records without duplicate side-effects

recovery_protocol.working_state_preservation: Maintains last committed valid revision; zero rollbacks or synthetic state alterations
